description: This Java class 'RunningService' models the runtime information of a service instance within the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages service metadata, execution timestamps, and provides methods for accessing and comparing running service instances.

classes.name: RunningService
classes.description: Represents a running instance of a service, capturing its name, model, mode, start, and end timestamps.

methods.name: RunningService
methods.description: Constructor initializing a RunningService with specified name, model, and mode; sets start timestamp to current time.

methods.name: getModelService
methods.description: Returns the ModelService associated with the running instance.

methods.name: getLocalName
methods.description: Returns the local name of the service.

methods.name: getMode
methods.description: Returns the mode of the service execution.

methods.name: getStartStamp
methods.description: Returns a clone of the start timestamp.

methods.name: getEndStamp
methods.description: Returns a clone of the end timestamp.

methods.name: setEndStamp
methods.description: Sets the end timestamp to the current time.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides the default equals method to compare running service instances based on model, mode, and start timestamp.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Provides a hash code based on the object's identity.
